Fire Protection Butterfly Valve

Lever-Operated Wafer Butterfly Valve

A manual lever-operated butterfly valve with a compact wafer body, sandwiched between two flanges in fire protection piping. A visible lever with a position-locking plate provides simple open/close control.

DN50–DN2002–8 inWaferPN16 / 1.6 MPaLever operated
Ask on WhatsAppView available models

Face-to-face dimension, flange drilling and marking are confirmed against the approved drawing, sample or order schedule before production.

Technical overview

Confirmed construction and operating data

Critical product data is presented in HTML for clear international sourcing. The valve is produced to a national standard; no foreign approval is claimed on this page.
